name: Parthenium (Congress grass)
management: Manual uprooting before flowering, competitive crops, biocontrol (Zygogramma)

name: Purple nutsedge (Motha)
management: Deep ploughing, clean seed, sulfonylurea herbicides

name: Littleseed canarygrass
management: Early sowing, clodinafop/sulfosulfuron (rotate modes of action)

name: Wild oats
management: Clean seed, crop rotation, post-emergence graminicides

name: Bermuda grass (Doob)
management: Repeated cultivation, mulch, glyphosate on fallow

name: Witchweed
management: Trap crops, resistant varieties, avoid contaminated seed
